rationale: §25.7 / §65.3.2: a `@name` that is a declared cell (not a theme token) lowers to the reactive-cell bridge `var(--scrml-name)`. The stylesheet's half of the bridge is that the use site reads it; the runtime's half writes `--scrml-name` (the page stands in for it). NOTE: impl#1's clientJs does NOT write `--scrml-<cell>` for a stylesheet rule (only for a flat inline `#{}`) — the bridge is dead end-to-end in impl#1 for scoped/global rules (progress.md, R26).
